## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) and the title is a Conventional Commit
- [ ] Tests or measurements verify the change
- [ ] ROADMAP.md box(es) ticked for items completed here (or n/a); no ID renumbered; `cargo xtask roadmap-check` is green
- [ ] No AGPL/GPL/non-commercial dependency or weights added; new files carry SPDX headers (or are covered by REUSE.toml)
- [ ] AI assistance disclosed if used (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Docs updated (PLAN or decision log) if a decision or design changed
